scenario.title: 描述心情的細微差別
scenario.context: 「還不錯」「蠻好的」「有點失望」「超級開心」，中文靠這些程度詞表達細膩情緒。英文的 quite、pretty、rather、fairly 也在做同樣的事，但美式和英式的理解差很多：英國人說 quite good，可能只是「還行」。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: So? Did you hear back from the London agency?
lines.zh: 所以呢？倫敦那家公司回覆你了嗎？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: I didn't get it. I'm pretty bummed, honestly.
lines.zh: 沒上。老實說我蠻沮喪的。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Oh no. I'm sorry. Did they give any feedback?
lines.zh: 喔不，我很遺憾。他們有給任何回饋嗎？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: They said my portfolio was quite good, but they went with someone more senior.
lines.zh: 他們說我的作品集 quite good，但選了資歷更深的人。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Careful. When British people say "quite good," it sometimes means "just OK."
lines.zh: 小心。英國人說 quite good 有時意思是「還行」。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Great, now I feel even worse.
lines.zh: 太好了，我現在感覺更糟了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Sorry! But being shortlisted is still fairly impressive.
lines.zh: 抱歉！但能進入決選名單還是蠻厲害的。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Guess what? My ceramics piece got into the exhibition! I'm over the moon.
lines.zh: 猜猜怎樣？我的陶藝作品入選展覽了！我開心到飛起來。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: No way! I'm so stoked for you!
lines.zh: 真的假的！我超替你興奮的！

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Thanks! But I'm also rather nervous. The opening night is next week.
lines.zh: 謝謝！但我也有點緊張，開幕夜是下週。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: That's normal. You've been a bit on edge all week, huh?
lines.zh: 很正常。你這整週都有點緊繃對吧？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Pretty much. I keep imagining people hating it.
lines.zh: 差不多。我一直想像大家會討厭它。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: They won't. And I'll be there, cheering the loudest.
lines.zh: 不會的。而且我會到場，歡呼得最大聲。

patterns.en: I'm pretty happy with how it turned out.
I'm a little on edge today.

chinglish.right: I'm absolutely thrilled! / I'm over the moon!
chinglish.why: 英文不疊 very，換成程度更強的詞（thrilled、ecstatic）或慣用語。

chinglish.wrong: I'm a little bit very sad.
chinglish.right: I'm pretty sad. / I'm quite upset.
chinglish.why: a little bit 和 very 互相矛盾。選一個程度就好。

chinglish.right: I'm not in a great mood. / I'm feeling a bit down.
chinglish.why: 「我心情不好」直翻 my mood is not good 很生硬。

chinglish.right: I'm so happy! / I'm so happy for you!
chinglish.why: happy for 用在替別人開心。

grammar.title: quite / pretty / rather / fairly
grammar.oneLiner: fairly < quite（英）/ pretty < rather < really / very < absolutely；美式的 quite 偏「很」，英式的 quite 常偏「還算」。
whenToUse: fairly：還算、尚可（語氣最弱）。It's fairly easy.
pretty：蠻、相當（美式口語最常用）。I'm pretty tired.
quite：美式 = 很（quite good ≈ very good）；英式常 = 還算（quite good ≈ fairly good）。
rather：相當、有點（常帶負面或意外，英式較常用）。It's rather expensive.
absolutely / totally：搭配極端形容詞（amazing, exhausted, thrilled）。不能說 very amazing。
a bit / a little / kind of / sort of：有點（口語）。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的「蠻」「挺」「相當」「有點」本身已經很細膩，但台灣人說英文時常只用 very 和 a little，讓情緒表達變得很平。另外，quite 在美英兩地的解讀不同，跟英國人合作時，聽到 quite good 別太開心。極端形容詞（amazing、exhausted）前面不能加 very，這也是常見錯誤。

examples.correct: The results were quite good, but there's room for improvement.
It was rather expensive for what it was.

examples.note: 極端形容詞用 absolutely / totally。

examples.correct: I'm kind of nervous about tomorrow.

quiz.question: A British client says your draft is "quite good." They probably mean:
options: It's OK, but it could be better.
quiz.explanation: 英式 quite good 常是「還行」。

quiz.question: I'm ___ nervous about the interview. (有點，口語兩個字)
quiz.explanation: kind of / a bit = 有點。

quiz.question: Which is correct?
quiz.explanation: exhausted 是極端形容詞，用 totally。

slang.usage: I'm bummed (out). = 我很失望／很掃興。

examples.en: I'm so bummed the concert got canceled.
Don't be bummed. There'll be other chances.
examples.zh: 別沮喪，還會有其他機會。

slang.usage: 源自衝浪文化。I'm stoked for… / I'm stoked about…

examples.en: I'm so stoked for our trip next week!
She was stoked to get the job.
examples.zh: 她拿到那份工作超興奮。

slang.meaning: 欣喜若狂、開心到飛起來
slang.usage: 非常開心。英式特別常用。

examples.en: My parents were over the moon when I told them the news.
examples.zh: 我告訴爸媽消息時，他們開心得不得了。

examples.en: I'm over the moon about the promotion!

slang.usage: 焦慮到容易被激怒或嚇到。

examples.en: Everyone's on edge before the layoff announcement.
examples.zh: 裁員公告前每個人都很緊繃。

examples.en: Too much coffee puts me on edge.
examples.zh: 咖啡喝太多會讓我很焦躁。

review.question: ___ you take a day off? You look exhausted.
review.explanation: 複習第 73 單元：Why don't you…?

review.question: ___ made me happy was that everyone came.
review.explanation: 複習第 72 單元：What 分裂句。

review.question: I wish I ___ so nervous before presentations.
review.explanation: 複習第 70 單元：現在的遺憾用過去式。

review.question: ___ patience is important when learning a language.
review.explanation: 複習第 66 單元：泛指抽象名詞不加冠詞。

review.question: I'm still not used to ___ in front of crowds.
review.explanation: 複習第 58 單元：be used to + V-ing。

review.question: We had a ___ at the opening night! (超好玩)
review.explanation: 複習第 10 單元：had a blast。
